repo.description: Cognitive Real-Time Execution System - Intelligent orchestration platform

executive.risk_summary: Low to moderate risk. Primary concerns are in dependency management and technical debt reduction. The codebase demonstrates solid engineering practices with good test coverage and documentation.
recommendations: Upgrade 12 outdated dependencies to latest stable versions
Reduce technical debt in core orchestrator modules (estimated 40h effort)
Improve test coverage in API layer from 65% to 80%
Implement automated security scanning in CI/CD pipeline

overview.business_summary: CORTEX is an enterprise-grade intelligent orchestration platform with strong architecture and good maintainability. The codebase demonstrates solid engineering practices with room for optimization in dependency management and test coverage. The system is production-ready with active development and comprehensive documentation.
key_strengths: Modular orchestrator architecture with clear separation of concerns
Comprehensive LENS analysis capabilities (git, AST, domain knowledge)
Strong governance framework with 7-agent enforcement system
Event-driven communication backbone for decoupled orchestration
areas_for_improvement: Dependency version management (12 packages need updates)
Test coverage gaps in API and infrastructure layers
Technical debt accumulation in legacy modules
Performance optimization opportunities in LENS analyzers
